Development of minerals
†116.DR. KIRODI LAL MEENA: Will the Minister of MINES be pleased to
state:
(a) the role of Central Government in development of minerals in the country,
especially, in leasing of mines/granting approval of mineral concessions to State
Governments;
(b) whether Indian Bureau of Mines acts as a regulator in the matters of
conservation and development of mines under the Mines and Minerals (Development
and Regulation) Act;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether the current system helps to put a check on iilegal mining in the
country; and
(e) if not, whether Government plans to make any change in the existing legal
framework of mining?
THE MINISTER OF MINES (SHRI PRALHAD JOSHI): (a) The Mines and
Minerals (Development and Regulation) (MMDR) Act, 1957 is the Central Act which
governs the development and regulation of mines and minerals in terms of the
powers vested in the Central Government as per Entry 54 of the Seventh Schedule
of the Constitution. The provisions of the MMDR ((hi1 Act, 1957 extend to the
whole of India.
The role of the Central Government is to formulate broad guidelines through
policies and enacting regulatory framework for grant of mineral concessions by the
State Governments and development of mineral deposits in the country. Accordingly,
the Central Government has notified the MMDR Act, 1957 which has been amended
from time to time. The last amendment was on 10.01.2020. The following set of Rules
have been framed under the MMDR Act for the purpose of development and
regulation of mineral deposits viz.
(i) The Mineral (Auction) Rules 2015.
(ii) The Mines and Minerals (Contribution to District Mineral Foundation)
Rules 2015.
†Original notice of the question was received in Hindi.

267[3 February, 2020]Written Answers to Unstarred Questions
(iii) National Mineral Exploration Trust Rules, 2015.
(iv) The Minerals (Evidence of Mineral Content) Rules, 2015.
(v) The Mineral (Non-exclusive Reconnaissance Permits) Rules, 2015.
(vi) The Minerals (Mining by Government Company) Rules, 2015.
(vii) The Minerals (Other than Atomic and Hydrocarbons Energy Minerals)
Concession Rules, 2016.
(viii) The Minerals Transfer of Mining Leases (Granted otherwise than through
Auction for Captive Purpose) Rules, 2016.
(ix) Atomic Mineral Concession Rules, 2016.
(x) Mineral Conservation and Development Rules, 2017.
The Central Government has framed Mineral Conservation and Development
Rules, (MCDR) 2017 under section 18 of MMDR Act, 1957 for the purpose of
Conservation and Development of minerals. In exercise of the powers conferred under
section 13 of the MMDR Act, 1957, the Central Government has enacted Mineral
(Auction; Rules, 2015. As per these rules, all mineral concessions ot major minerals
has to be granted by the respective State Governments only through e-auctions,
which will bring greater transparency and remove discretion in allocation of mineral
resources.
(b) and (c) Indian Bureau of Mines acts as a regulator in the Matters of
conservation and development of mines under the Mines and Minerals (Development
and Regulation) Act and Rules made thereunder. The charter of functions in respect
of indian Bureau of Mines includes:
(i) Collect, collate, and organise into a database, all information on exploration,
prospecting, mines and minerals in the country in the shape of a National
Mineral Information Repository and take steps to publish and disseminate
the same;
(ii) Function as the National Technical Regulator in respect of the mining
sector, and lay down regulations, procedures and systems to guide the
State Governments (first tier of regulation);

268 [RAJYA SABHA]Written Answers to Unstarred Questions
(iii) Build up capacity in the system, both for regulatory as well as the
developmental work, at the central level as well as at the level of the
States;
(iv) Establish institutional mechanisms of coordination between the Centre, the
States, mineral industry, research and academic institutions, and all stake
holders, so as to proactively develop solutions to the demands and
problems faced by the industry;
(v) Promote research on all aspects of practical relevance to the industry and
to act as a bridge between research institutions on the one hand and
user industry on the other;
(vi) Provide technical consultancy services;
(vii) Participate in international collaborative projects in the area of regulation
and development of the mineral sector;
(viii) Advise Government on all ma tters relating to the mineral industry; and
(ix) Undertake any such other activity as has become necessary in the light
of developments in the field of geology, mining, mineral beneficiation and
the environment.
(d) and (e) As per section 23C of the MMDR Act, 1957, State Governments
have full powers to make rules for preventing illegal mining, transportation and
storage of minerals and for the purposes connected therewith. To strengthen the
States in curbing the illegal Mining, the Central Government, inter-alia, has taken
the following measures:
(i) The MMDR Act, 1957 was amended with effect from 12.01.2015, under
which the penalty and punishment provisions for illegal mining was made
very stringent. Illegal mining has been made punishable with imprisonment
for a term which may extend to five years and with fine which may extend
to five lakh rupees per hectare of the area.
(ii) Provisions have been made for setting up of Special Courts for the
purpose of providing speedy trial of offences relating to illegal mining.

269[3 February, 2020]Written Answers to Unstarred Questions
(iii) The Rule 45 of Mineral Conservation and Development Rules has been
amended so that the mining companies provide periodic reports on the
production, trade and utilization of minerals to the State Government and
IBM on daily / monthly /yearly basis for a proper end-to-end accounting
of minerals diminishing the scope for illegal mining, royalty evasion, etc.
(iv) The Ministry of Mines, through IBM has developed the Mining
Surveillance System (MSS), to use space technology for facilitating State
Governments in curbing illegal mining activities in the country. MSS is a
satellite-based monitoring system which aims to establish a regime of
responsive mineral administration, through public participation, by
facilitating State Governments in curbing instances of illegal mining.

rose 29 per cent between December, 2019 and January, 2020 even after rollout of
electronic toll collection through FASTags;

(c) the details of steps taken or proposed to be taken by Government to
reduce the waiting time of vehicles at toll plazas?

except one fee lane in each direction are to be declared as dedicated FASTag Lane
of the fee plaza. As a result, the waiting time in the hybrid lane which accepts
cash has increased because of non-FASTag vehicles. Waiting time in dedicated
FASTag lanes has significantly reduced. It has been observed that more waiting
time in cash lanes vis-a-vis FASTag lanes has worked as catalyst for adoption of
FASTag. As on 28.01.2020, more than 1.4 Crores FASTag have been issued and
approximately 1 lakh FASTag are being issued on a daily basis. Waiting time will
further reduce in future with further adoption of FASTag by non-FASTag vehicles.

such as social media, print media, hoardings, advertisements, etc. Multiple channels
and Point of Sale (PoS) have been operating including e-commerce platforms for

easy availability of FASTag to customers. In December 2019, Government has

146. SHRI A. MOHAMMEDJAN: Will the Minister of SHIPPING be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government push for movement of goods through
waterways has resulted in shift of cargo from road and rail to coastal waterways;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the annual growth of cargo moved through
coastal waterways has increased by ten times since this Government came to power;
(c) whether the growth rate was only 1.4 per cent between 2009-10 and
2013-14; and
(d) whether this growth rate has increased to 14.2 per cent during 2014-15
and 2017-18 period?
THE MINISTER OF STA TE OF THE MINISTRY OF SHIPPING (SHRI
MANSUKH MANDA VIYA): (a) and (b) Government has undertaken number of
initiatives towards facilitating trade and increasing share of coastal shipping thus
resulting in increase of coastal cargo traffic from 172.67 million tonnes in FY 2014-
15 to 262.56 in FY 2018-19. The annual growth rate during 2014-15 till 2018-19 is
approx. 11.05 %.
(c) and (d) The growth rate for volume of coastal cargo between 2009-10 to
2013-14 was 1.4% while it has increased to 10.51% between FY 2014-15 to FY
2017-18.

Increase in coastal cargo traffic
152. SHRI A. K. SELV ARAJ: Will the Minister of SHIPPING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during the last financial year coastal cargo traffic
handled by ports stood at 234 million tonnes, which was 16 per cent more;

318 [RAJYA SABHA]Written Answers to Unstarred Questions
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that thermal coal is the main commodity, which
is transported through coastal waterways; and
(d) whether more players will shift to coastal movement of such cargo rather
than depending on road and rail?
THE MINISTER OF STATE OF THE MINISTRY OF SHIPPING (SHRI
MANSUKH MANDA VIYA): (a) and (b) The total coastal cargo traffic handled by
Indian Ports in the last FY 2018-19 was 262.56 million tonnes which was 12.68%

initiatives to promote shift of cargo including thermal coal from road/rail to coastal
waterways.
Ban on NDTL by WADA
153. SHRI K. C. RAMAMURTHY: Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the World Anti Doping Agency (WADA) has
banned India's National Dope Testing Laboratory (NDTL) recently;
(b) whether it means that NDTL is now banned to undertake any anti-doping
activities;
(c) the impact of this on country's anti-doping efforts;
(d) whether it is also a fact that the decision forced India to send its samples
to other W ADA approved laboratories in other countries, thereby increasing the cost;
and
(e) the impact it will have on the forthcoming Olympics in Japan?
THE MINISTER OF STATE OF THE MINISTRY OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS (SHRI KIREN RIJIJU): (a) No Sir, the World Anti Doping Agency (WADA)
has not banned National Dope Testing Laboratory (NDTL). W ADA has suspended
the accreditation of NDTL with effect from 20.08.2019 for a period of six months.

319[3 February, 2020]Written Answers to Unstarred Questions
(b) and (c) NDTL is dope testing laboratory. The anti-doping activities in India
are carried out by National Anti Doping Agency (NADA) and therefore, anti-doping
efforts are not impacted.
(d) Sample for dope testing can be analysed only by W ADA accredited
laboratories. NADA is sending samples for dope testing to WADA accredited
laboratory at Doha, which involve slight additional cost for posting and
transportation of samples to theses laboratories.
(e) There is no impact of suspension of NDTL on forthcoming Tokyo
Olympic 2020.
Kabaddi in Olympics
†154.SHRI HARNATH SINGH YADAV: Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether any effort has ever been made by Government to include the
ancient and extremely popular game of India i.e. Kabaddi in the Olympics; if so,
the details thereof;

in the country and abroad; and

THE MINISTER OF STATE OF THE MINISTRY OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND

IOC has prescribed that a sport discipline must be governed by an International
Federation which undertakes to follow the rules of the Olympic Charter and it must
also be practised widely across the world and meet various criteria. It is for the
International Kabaddi Federation to take required steps for inclusion of Kabaddi in
Olympic Games.

initiatives/measures:–

training programmes and sporting events.
(ii) Inclusion of Kabaddi in Khelo India Youth Games and Khelo India
University Games.

Cases of sexual harassment in SAI
158. SHRIMA TI VANDANA CHA VAN: Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of sexual harassment cases filed by sportspersons in Sports
Authority of India (SAI) against coaches/SAI officials during the last three years
and current year;
(b) whether any action has been taken against those found guilty in such
cases, and if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether all training centres under SAI have their respective Internal
Complaints Committees (ICCs) or alternative forums which women can approach in
such cases; and
(d) whether any steps have been taken to increase awareness about sexual
harassment in SAI training centres, including gender sensitisation of male coaches,
and if so, the details thereof?
THE MINISTER OF STATE OF THE MINISTRY OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS (SHRI KIREN RIJIJU): (a) A total of 23 cases of sexual harassment have
been reported by sportspersons in Sports Authority of India (SAI) against coaches/
SAI officials during the last 3 years and current year.
(b) Yes, Sir. SAI has terminated services of 3 (three) officers and punished 1
(one) officer with minor penalty. Charges against 2 (two) officers were not established

and 4 (four) complaints were withdrawn by complainants. The remaining 13 (thirteen)

Complaints Committees (ICCs) or alternative forum where female athlete/staff can
approach in such cases.
(d) The details of the steps taken to increase awareness about sexual
harassment in SAI training centres are as under:–
(i) Workshops in local languages conducted in all SAI centres.
(ii) Call centre facility is operational where trainees/any individual can lodge
grievances.
(iii) T eams are accompanied with Lady Coaches/Lady Managers during any
movement out of the camps.
(iv) Lady Wardens have been appointed in every training centre where lodging
facilities are given to female trainees.

भारत सरकार 
पयाᭅवरण, वन और जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन मंᮢालय 
रा᭔ य सभा 
अतारांᳰकत ᮧ᭫ न सं. 45 
03.02.2020 को उ᭜ तर क े िलए 
भूिम का मᱨ᭭थलीकरण 
45.  ᮰ीमती वंदना च᭪हाण :  
᭍या पयाᭅवरण, वन और जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन मंᮢी यह बताने कᳱ क ृ पा करᱶगे ᳰक :  
(क)  देशभर मᱶ क ु ल ᳰकतनी भूिम का ᭃरण या मᱨ᭭थलीकरण हो गया है;  
(ख)  ᭍या यह सच है ᳰक मᱨ᭭थलीकरण क े कारण देशभर मᱶ ज᭠तुᲐ  कᳱ क ु छ ᮧजाितयां िवलु᳙ हो 
गई हᱹ;  
(ग)  यᳰद हां, तो त᭜ संबंधी ᭣यौरा ᭍या है; और  
(घ)  26 िमिलयन हे᭍टेयर ᭃरण हो चुकᳱ भूिम का वषᭅ 2030 तक जीणᲃ᳍ार करने क े अपने ल᭯य 
को पूरा करने क े िलए मंᮢालय ने कौन-कौन से कदम उठाए हᱹ या उठाने कᳱ योजना बना 
रहा है? 
उ᭜ तर   
पयाᭅवरण, वन और जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन रा᭔ य मंᮢी   
(᮰ी बाबुल सुिᮧयो) 
(क) अंतᳯरᭃ  अनु ᮧयोग क े᭠ ᮤ ᳇ारा वष ᭅ 2011-2013 कᳱ अविध क े  िलए तैयार ᳰकए गए भारतीय 
मᱨ᭭ थलीकरण और भूिम अव ᮓमण एटलस क े  अनुसार, देश क ᳱ 29.32% अथाᭅत् 96.4 िमिलयन 
हे᭍ टेयर भूिम अवᮓिमत हो रही है।  
(ख) और (ग)   भारतीय ᮧाणी सव ᱷᭃण ᳇ारा देश म ᱶ जंतुओᱶ कᳱ ᳰक᭠ हᱭ ऐसी ᮧजाितयᲂ क े  िवषय मᱶ 
सूिचत नहᱭ ᳰकया गया है जो मᱨ᭭ थलीकरण क े  कारण िवलु᭡ त हो चुकᳱ हᲂ।  
(घ)  रा᭬ ᮝीय वनीकरण और पा ᳯरि᭭थितकᳱय िवकास बोड ᭅ (एनएईबी), जो पयाᭅवरण, वन और जलवायु 
पᳯरवतᭅन मंᮢालय का एक ᮧभाग है, अवᮓिमत वन ᭃेᮢᲂ कᳱ पाᳯरि᭭थितकᳱय   बहाली हेतु, ‘‘रा᭬ ᮝीय 
वनीकरण कायᭅᮓम (एनएपी)’’ कायाᭅि᭠वत कर रहा है, िजसक े  तहत 3874 करोड़ ᱨ. कᳱ लागत से 
2 िमिलयन हे ᭍ टेयर से अिधक भू -ᭃेᮢ  पर वनीकरण क ᳱ मंजूरी ᮧदान क ᳱ गई है। एनएपी क े  तहत , 
कायाᭅ᭠ वयन क े  ᭃेᮢ  मᱶ िमᲵी कᳱ आᮤᭅता कᳱ ि᭭थित मᱶ सुधार लाने हेतु मृदा आᮤᭅता संरᭃ ण कायᭅकलापᲂ मᱶ 
सहयोग करने क े साथ-साथ ᭭ थानीय लोगᲂ क े  िलए आजीिवका उपल᭣ ध कराने मᱶ भी सहयोग ᳰकया जाता 
है। िविवध काय ᭅकलापᲂ, िविवध ल ᭯ यᲂ और िविवध लाभ ᲂ से समि ᭠वत यह दृि ᳥कोण ᮧ᭭ तािवत भूिम

उपयुᭅक ्   त के अलावा, ᮧितपूरक वनीकरण कोष िनयम, 2018 मᱶ, राज्  य/संघ राज्  य ᭃ ेᮢᲂ ᳇ारा जंगल कᳱ

᭍या पयाᭅवरण, वन और जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन मंᮢी यह बताने कᳱ क ृ पा करᱶगे ᳰक :

कराए जा रहे हᱹ? 
उ᭜ तर 
 
पयाᭅवरण, वन और जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन रा᭔ य मंᮢी 
(᮰ी बाबुल सुिᮧयो) 
 
(क) से (ग) क ुछ ᮧमुख ᮧाक ृ ितक आपदाᲐ  क े पᳯरणाम᭭ वᱨ प या और अिधक अनुक ू ल पᳯरि᭭थितयᲂ मᱶ आजीिवकाᲐ  को ᮧा᭡ त 
करने क े  िलए ᮧवास करना एक सवᭅिवᳰदत घटना है। तथािप, देश क े भीतर ᮧवास कᳱ ऐसी कोई घटनाएं नहᱭ देखी गई हᱹ िजनका 
मानव जिनत कारणᲂ से वैि ᳡ क तापन क े संबंध मᱶ ᳰकए गए ᳰकसी यथे᭬ ट उपाय से ᮧ᭜ यᭃ  संबंध हो। अनेक सरकारी िवभाग ᲂ क े 
कायᭅ मᱶ िविभ᭠ न कᱶ ᮤीय और रा ᭔ य सरकारᲂ ᳇ारा तथा अनेक सरकारी और गैर -सरकारी अिभकरण ᲂ, िशᭃा-सं᭭ थानᲂ और 
िसिवल सोसायटी संगठनᲂ क े  कायᭅ क े  मा᭟ यम से ᮧवास पैटनᭅ कᳱ िनरंतर ᱨ प से िनगरानी कᳱ जाती है।  
भारत सरकार अपने िविभ ᭠ न कायᭅᮓमᲂ और ᭭ कᳱमᲂ क े  मा᭟ यम से जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन का सामना करने कᳱ ᳰदशा मᱶ ᮧितब᳍  है। 
इसमᱶ, अ᭠ य बातᲂ क े  साथ-साथ, रा᭬ ᮝीय जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन कायᭅ योजना (एनएपीसीसी) का  ᳰᮓया᭠ वयन शािमल है जोᳰक 
सौर-ऊजाᭅ, ऊजाᭅ दᭃता, जल, क ृ िष, िहमालयी पा ᳯर-ᮧणाली, सतत पयाᭅवास, हᳯरत भारत और जलवायु प ᳯरवतᭅन 
संबंधी रणनीितक ᭄ान क े  िविश᭬ ट ᭃेᮢᲂ संबंधी िमशनᲂ से यु᭍ त है। एनएपीसीसी मᱶ सभी जलवायु संबंधी कारᭅवाइयᲂ क े  िलए एक 
समावेशी कायᭅढांचे का ᮧावधान ᳰकया गया है। त ᱹतीस रा᭔ यᲂ/संघ रा᭔ य ᭃेᮢᲂ ने जलवायु प ᳯरवतᭅन से संबंिधत रा᭔ य क े  िविश᭬ ट 
मु᳎ᲂ को ᭟ यान मᱶ रखते ᱟए एनएपीसीसी क ᳱ तजᭅ पर अपनी-अपनी रा᭔ य जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन कायᭅ योजनाएं (एसएपीसीसी) 
तैयार कर ली ह ᱹ। इन एसएपीसीसी मᱶ , अ᭠ य बातᲂ क े साथ -साथ, अनुक ू लन सिहत ᭃेᮢ  िविश ᭬ ट और अंतर ᭃेᮢ ीय 
ᮧाथिमकताᲐ  वाली कार ᭅवाइयᲂ कᳱ ᱨ परेखा दी गई है। रा ᭔ यᲂ और संघ रा ᭔ य ᭃेᮢᲂ मᱶ इस अनुक ू लन कारᭅवाई क े िलए रा᭬ ᮝीय 
जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन अनुक ू लन िनिध (एनएएफसीसी) से सहायता दी जाएगी।  
भारत, अंतर-सरकारी जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन पैनल (आइपीसीसी) का एक पᭃकार है जो ᳰक जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन संबंधी िव᭄ान का 
आकलन करने क े  िलए वष ᭅ 1988 मᱶ ᭭ थािपत एक अंतर -सरकारी पैनल है। आइपीसीसी मᱶ नीित िनमाᭅताᲐ  को जलवायु 
पᳯरवतᭅन, इसक े  िनिहताथᲄ और संभािवत भावी जोिखम ᲂ क े  संबंध मᱶ िनयिमत वै᭄ािनक आकलन करने क े  ᮧावधान क े  साथ-
साथ अनुक ू लन और उपशमन रणनीितयᲂ का ᮧ᭭ ताव ᳰकया गया है। भारत सिहत संपूणᭅ िव᭫ व क े  वै᭄ािनक, आइपीसीसी आकलन 
ᳯरपोटᱸ तैयार करने म ᱶ योगदान देते हᱹ। आइपीसीसी क े  िविभ᭠ न आकलन अ᭟ ययनᲂ क े अनुसार, ᮧवास क े  आधारभूत सामािजक, 
आᳶथक और पयाᭅवरणीय कारक, जᳯटल और िविवध होते हᱹ; इसिलए अवलोकन ᳰकए गए जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन क े  ᮧभाव का पता 
लगाने या िव᭫ वास क े  ᳰकसी भी ᭭ तर क े  साथ इसक े  संभािवत पᳯरमाण का आकलन करना चुनौतीपूणᭅ है। जलवायु पᳯरवतᭅन और 
भूिम संबंधी आइपीसीसी कᳱ िवशेष ᳯरपोटᭅ (2019) क े  अनुसार जलवायु, देशᲂ क े  अंदर और सीमा पार , दोनᲂ म ᱶ 
पयाᭅवरणीय दृि᳥ से ᮧेᳯरत ᮧवास को बढ़ा सकती  है। इसक े  अितᳯर᭍ त, 1.50 से. क े  वैि᳡ क तापन संबंधी आइपीसीसी कᳱ 
िवशेष ᳯरपोटᭅ (2018) क े अनुसार, 20 से. तापन पर कᳯटबंधᲂ मᱶ बसे लोगᲂ का बड़ी सं᭎ या मᱶ िव᭭ थापन होने कᳱ संभावना 
है।

भारत सरकार  
भारी उद्योग एवं लोक उद्यम मंत्रालय 
भारी उद्योग ववभाग 
 
राज्य सभा 
अतारांककत प्रश्न सं. 75 
सोमवार , 03 फरवरी , 2020 को उत्तर क े  वलए वियत 
 
ऑटोमोबाइल की वबक्री में कमी 
75. श्री पी.एल. पुविया: 
क्या भारी उद्योग और लोक उद्यम मंत्री यह बतािे की  क ृपा करेंगे ककिः 
 
(क)  क्या यह सच है कक देश में दोपवहया, वतपवहया और चौपवहया वाहिों की वबक्री में भारी कमी आई 
है; 
(ख) यकद हां, तो वर्ष 2018 की तुलिा में 2019 में ककतिे वाहि कम वबक े  हैं और ककतिे डीलर शोरूम 
बंद हुए हैं, तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है; 
(ग) वाहिों की वबक्री में कमी से प्रत्यक्ष और अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से हुई रोजगार में कमी का ब्यौरा क्या है; 
(घ) ऑटो उद्योग को प्रोत्सावहत करिे क े  वलए सरकार द्वारा क्या-क्या प्रयास ककए जा रहे हैं; और 
(ङ) उक्त प्रयासों से ऑटो सेक्टर को वमली राहत का ब्यौरा क्या है? 
 
उत्तर 
भारी उद्योग और लोक  उद्यम मंत्री 
(श्री प्रकाश जावडेकर ) 
(क) से (ग ): कई अर्षव्यवस्र्ाओं में चक्रीय मंदी है। अप्रैल-कदसम्बर, 2018 की अववध क े  दौराि बेचे गए 
20.3 वमवलयि वाहिों की तुलिा में अप्रैल से कदसम्बर, 2019 की अववध क े  दौराि 17.1 वमवलयि वाहिों 
(सभी श्रेवियों में) की वबक्री हुई है। उद्योग द्वारा अस्र्ाई कायषबल की छंटिी की सूचिा दी गई है। तर्ावप, 
सरकार क े  पास िौकरी खोिे से संबंवधत कोई पुष्ट आँकडे उपलब्ध िहीं हैं। 
(घ) और (ङ): िीवत विमाषता क े  रूप में, सरकार ऑटो सेक्टर क े  व्यापक और विरन्तर ववकास क े वलए 
आवश्यकतािुसार उपाय क े  पैक े ज क े  माध्यम से अर्षव्यवस्र्ा की गवत को बिाए रखिे और ववकास हेतु 
सदैव
 प्रयास करती है। ऑटोमोबाइल मंदी से विपटिे क े  वलए सरकार द्वारा उठाए गए क ु छ कदमों को संक्षेप 
में विम्नवलवखत रूप में प्रस्तुत ककया जा सकता है: 
 कॉपोरेट कर में 22% की कमी । 
 आईसीई और ईवी की भववष्य में पंजीकरि की विरंतरता।   
 स्क्र ै पेज िीवत ववचाराधीि। 
 जूि, 2020 तक िई कारों क े पंजीकरि में प्रस्ताववत वृवि स्र्वगत। 
 पीएसयू बैंकों को ₹70,000 करोड की रावश जारी की गई।  
 खरीदे गए वाहि क े  वलए रेपो दर को ब्याज से जोडिा।

(घ): प्रश्न िहीं उठता।

(क )  क्या यह सच  है कक  देश में 70 प्रततशत छोटी नददयाां सूख गई हैं;  
(ख)  क्या यह भी सच  है कक  सभी नदी घादटयों में सांसाधन मानचचत्रण तथा समुदाय  द्वारा सांचालित जि

(ग)  क्या नदी  सांरक्षण के  लिए जनता  की  भागीदारी  अतनवाया है; और  
(घ)  यदद हाां, तो  सरकार  इस सांबांध में क्या-क्या कदम  उठाने का  ववचार  रखती  है? 
उत्तर 
जल शक्तत और सामाक्जक न याय एिं अकधकातरता राज् य मंत्री (श्री रतन लाल कटातरया)  
(क ) और (ख ) देश में दो तरह की नददयाां अथाात बारहमासी और गैर -बारहमासी नददयाां होती हैं। बारहमासी 
नददयाां वे हैं जजनमें पूरे वर्ा जि उपिब्ध रहता है और गैर -बारहमासी नददयाां वे होती हैं जो वर्ाापोवर्त नददयाां 
हैं और जजनमें जि केवि वर्ाापात की अवचध के दौरान ही बहता है। नदी में जि का प्रवाह एक डायनलमक 
पैरामीटर है और यह बह ुत से उप -पैरामीटरों जैसे वर्ाा, आवाह क्षेत्र में इसकी ववतरण अवचध और सघनता , 
आवाह क्षेत्र की दशा, वनस्पतत और जि की तनकासी/उपयोग पर तनभार करता है।  
यद्यवप, क ुछ ववशेर्ज्ञों की ररपोटों में नददयों में जि के बहाव में कमी होने के सांबांध में चचांता व्यक्त की गई 
है। देश में वृहद/महत्वपूणा नददयों के लिए वपछिे 20 वर्ों में केन्द्रीय जि आयोग द्वारा अनुरक्षक्षत वावर्ाक 
औसत जि बहाव आांकडा जि उपिब्धता में ककसी भी ववलशष्ट कमी को नहीां दशााता है। तथावप, केन्द्रीय जि 
आयोग के अन ुसार देश में प्रतत व्यजक्त वावर्ाक जि उपिब्धता में जनसांख्या, शहरीकरण, िोगों के बेहतर 
जीवन प्रणािी इत्यादद की वजह से तेजी से कमी आई है।  
केन्द्रीय भूलम जि बोडा (सीजीडब््य ूबी) “राष्रीय जिभृत मैवपांग और प्रबांधन (एनएक्यूयूआईएम)” का एक 
राष्रस्तरीय कायाक्रम कायााजन्द्वत कर रहा है जजसमें भूलम जि सांसाधन के सतत ववकास के लिए जिभ ृतों की  
मैवपांग, जिभ ृत प्रबांधन योजनाओां को तैयार और ववकास करने की ववशेर्ताएां शालमि हैं। जिभ ृत मानचचत्रों 
और प्रबांधन योजनाओां को सांबांचधत राज्य सरकार  के  अलभकरणों के साथ साझा ककया गया है। स्टेक हो्डरों 
के िाभ के लिए जिभ ृत प्रबांधन योजनाओां के लसद्धाांतों का प्रचार-प्रसार करने के लिए ब ुतनयादी स्तर पर 
सावाजतनक जनसांपका कायाक्रम आयोजजत ककए जा रहे हैं। च ूांकक जि राज्य का ववर्य है , देश में भूजि के  
सांरक्षण और प्रबांधन सदहत जि प्रबांधन की पहि करना म ुख्यतया राज्यों की जजम्मेदारी है। 
(ग) और (घ ) सावाजतनक भागीदारी , नदी सांरक्षण/पुनरूद्धार कायाक्रम का एक बह ुत महत्वप ूणा घटक है। 
राष्रीय नदी सांरक्षण योजना और नमालम गांगे कायाक्रम के तहत जागरूकता अलभयान/प्रका शन, पांफिेट्स, 
वीडडयो कफ्म, यात्रा, स्िोगन/ड्राइांग/प्रस्ताव प्रततयोचगताओां इत्यादद के माध्यम से नददयों के मू्य, कायों और 
पाररजस्थततकीय सेवाओां के बारे में स्थानीय िोगों, छात्रों और स्टेक हो्डरों को लशक्षक्षत और जागरूक करने 
सदहत ववलभन्द्न सांरक्षण/पुनरूद्धार कायाकिापों को करने के लिए भाग िेने वािे राज्यों को ववत्तीय सहायता दी 
जाती है।

पवपनमय बोडग (सेबी) में पंजीक ृ त व् यपक्तर्त वैकपल्पक पनवेश पनपर्यों (एबाईएफ) में वचनबद्धता की जा रही हैं।

पारंपररक उद्योगों को पुनर्जीवित ककए र्जाने क े 
अंतगगत स्थावपत क्लस्टर 
 
104. श्री वि॰ विर्जयसाई रेड्ीीः  
 
क्या सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यम मंत्री यह बताने की क ृपा करें गे  ककीः 
 
(क ) क्या यह सच है कक सरकार देश में  पारंपररक उद्योगों को पुनर्जीवित करने क े  वलए एक योर्जना लागू कर 
रही है ; 
(ख) यकद हां, तो योर्जना क े लक्ष्य और उद्देश्य क्या हैं; 
(ग ) उक्त योर्जना क े  अंतगगत आंध्र प्रदेश में स्थावपत क्लस्टरों का ब्यौरा क्या है; 
(घ) क्या यह भी सच है कक सरकार प्रत्येक वर्जले में कम से कम एक क्लस्टर स्थावपत करने का लक्ष्य रखती है; 
और  
(ङ) यकद हां, तो आंध्र प्रदेश में स्थावपत/स्थापना क े  वलए प्रस्तावित प्रत्येक क्लस्टर और उक्त प्रत्येक क्लस्टर क े  
अंतगगत विकवसत ककए र्जा रहे पारंपररक  उद्योगों का ब्यौरा क्या है? 
 
उत्तर  
सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यम मंत्री 
(श्री वनवतन गडकरी) 
 
(क ) र्जी, हााँ। सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यम मंत्रालय ‘परंपरागत उद्योगों क े पुनगसृर्जन क े  वलए वनवि स्कीम’ 
(स्फ ू र्तग) कायागववित कर रही है वर्जसक े  अंतगगत परंपरागत उद्योग क्लस्टर अथागत खादी कयर और ग्रामोद्योग 
क्लस्टर स्थावपत करने क े  वलए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की र्जा रही  है।  
 
(ख) स्फ ू र्तग स्कीम क े  उद्देश्य वनम्नवलवखत हैीः 
i) पांच िर्षों से अविक अिवि में देश में परंपरागत उद्योगों क े  क्लस्टरों को विकवसत करना।  
ii) परं परागत उद्योगों को अविक प्रवतस्पिी, बार्जारू, उत्पादक और लाभकारी बनाना। 
iii) स्थानीय स्टेकहोल्डरों की सकिय भागीदारी सवहत उद्योग क्लस्टरों की स्थानीय अवभशासन  
प्रणाली को सशक्त बनाना ताकक उवहें विकास पहलों क े  वलए सक्षम बनाया र्जा सक े ।  
iv) निप्रितगनकारी और परंपरागत कौशल उन्नत प्रौद्योवगककयों, उन्नत प्रकियाओं, बार्जार आसूचना  
और सािगर्जवनक वनर्जी भागीदारों क े  नए मॉडलों का वनमागण करना ताकक क्लस्टर आिाररत सृवर्जत 
परंपरागत उद्योगों की िीरे -िीरे समान मॉडलों की अनुक ृवत तैयार की र्जा सक े । 
 
(ग ) आंध्र प्रदेश में स्फ ू र्तग क े अंतगगत स्थावपत क्लस्टरों का ब्यौरा अनुबंि-I में कदया गया है।  
 
(घ) मंत्रालय ने प्रत्येक वर्जले में एक क्लस्टर स्थावपत करने क े वलए कोई वनणगय नहीं वलया है।  
 
(ङ) प्रश्न नहीं उठता।

 क्या सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्ीम द्ीम मत्ी  यह बताने की  क ृपा करेंगे ककिः  
 
(क )  क्या केन्द्र सरकार की योजनाएं और नीततयां एमएसएमई श्रममकों पर भी लाग ू होती हैं, यदि हां, 
 तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है;

(ग )  क्या सरकार एमएसएमई श्रममकों के मलए कोई योजनाएं श ुरू करने पर विचार कर रही  है? 
 
दत् तर  
सूक्ष् म, लघु और मध् ीम द्ीम मत्ी  
(श्री न नत  गडकरख )  
 
(क) से (ग) : स ूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यमों (एमएसएमई ) के कामगारों के  मलए योजना में असंगदित 
क्षेत्रों के कामगारों के मलए एक पेंशन योजना - प्रधानमंत्री श्रम योगी मान -धन योजना (पीएमएस िाईएमडी ) 
और कामगारों के मलए श्र म और रोजगार मंत्रालय की संशोगधत एकीक ृत आिासीय योजना 
(आरआईएचएस) सम्मममलत है। इसके अततररक्त , प्रधानमंत्री 
जीिन ज्योतत बीमा योजना (पीएमजेजेबीिाई ); 
प्रधानमंत्री सुरक्षा बीमा योजना (पीएमएसबीिाई ); प्रधानमंत्री जन धन योजना (पीएमजेडीिाई ) जैसी 
कल्याणकारी योजनाओं का कायाान्द्ियन ककया गया है म्जनका लाभ कामगारों को भी उपलब्ध है।  
 
 एमएसएमई मंत्रालय प्रौद्योगगकी केन्द्रों, एमएसएमई -विकास संस्थानों, खािी और ग्रामोद्योग 
आयोग (केिीआईसी ), राष्ट्रीय लघु उद्योग तनगम (एनएसआईसी
), कॅयर बोडा, एमएसएमई राष्ट्रीय संस्थान 
के माध्यम से कौशल विकास को बढािा िेता है।  
 
 इसी प्रकार, प्रमशक्षण महातनिेशालय (डीजीटी) द्िारा मशल्पकार प्रमशक्षण योजना (सीटीएस), प्रमशक्षु 
प्रमशक्षण योजना (एटीएस), मशल्प प्रमशक्षक प्रमशक्षण योजना (सीआईटीएस), उन्द्नत व्यािसातयक प्रमशक्षण 
योजना (एिीटीएस) जैसी योजनाओं के माध्यम से व्यािसातयक प्रमशक्षण आयोम्जत ककए जाते हैं म्जनमें 
मदहला व्यािसातयक प्रमशक्षण कायाक्रम भी सम्मममलत है।  
 
 इसी तरह , क ुशल भारत ममशन के अंतगात , कौशल विकास और उद्यममता मंत्रालय द्िारा 
अल्पकामलक प्रमशक्षण (एसटीटी) और ररकगतनशन ऑफ प्रायर लतनिंग (आरपीएल) के मलए प्रधानमंत्री 
कौशल विकास योजना (पीएमकेिीिाई ) जैसी प्रमुख योजनाओं का कायाान्द्ियन ककया जाता है।

(a) Ayushman Bharat -Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) was 
launched in September,  2018. Since then, expenditure has shown an upward trend. 
From September, 2018 until the end of FY 2018-19, a total of Rs.1849.55 crore were

amounts to Rs. 3520.48 crore.

followed which has ensured appropriate utilization of resources and prevented 
unjustified parking of funds at the State level. The reasons for relatively slower than

Reasons for low utilization of funds allocated under Pradhan Mantri   Jan  Arogya  
Yojana (PMJAY)

20% of the eligible beneficiary population, are not implementing AB-PMJAY.

beneficiary population are implementing the Scheme for the first time and hence, 
their demand is still picking up.

family per annum. However, this had been estimated at Rs. 1052 at the time of 
the inception of PMJAY.

I. Beneficiary  awareness  and  e-card generation 
(a) Awareness campaign on all medias of communications are being undertaken. 
(b) States/UTs have been advised to generate e-cards in mission mode. 
(c) States/UTs are conducting beneficiary verification drive. 
II. Hospital Empanelment 
(a) All eligible public hospitals across Ministries and States are being empanelled in 
a mission mode for increased availability of healthcare service providers. 
(b) Further, in this direction States/UTs have been asked to empanel tertiary .  care 
health providers including private medical colleges.

(a) Monitoring of claim settlements in the respective States/UTs.

Statement 
(a) and (b) The National Medical Commission Act 2019 (NMC) has following 
provision related to the National Exit Test. Section 15 of the NMC Act 2019 states: 
"(1)  A common final year undergraduate medical examination, to be known as 
the National Exit Test, shall be held for granting licence to practice medicine 
as medical practitioners and for enrolment in the State Register or the 
National Register, as the case may be. 
(2) The Commission shall conduct the National Exit Test through such 
designated authority and  in  such  manner as  may  be  specified  by  
regulations. 
(3) The National Exit Test shall become operational on such date, within three 
years from the date of commencement of this Act, as may be appointed by 
the Central Government, by notification. 
(4) Any person with a foreign medical qualification shall have to qualify National 
Exit Test for the purpose of obtaining licence to practice medicine as medical 
practitioner and for enrolment in the State Register or the National Register, 
as the case may be, in such manner as may be specified by regulations.

broad- speciality medical education in medical institutions which are

being in force and shall be done in such manner as may be specified by 
regulations.

common counselling by the designated authority for admission to the 
postgraduate broad- speciality seats in the medical institutions referred to in 
sub-section (5)"

THE MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF FINANCE (SHRI ANURAG  SINGH

Statement 
(a) to (d) With regard to frauds with banks on account of digital transactions, 
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has informed that it does not collect data on frauds under 
the category 'Digital Transaction', while making available data on fraud as reported by 
Scheduled Commercial Banks (SCBs) and select Financial Inst itutions (FIs) for 
amount involving Rs.1 lakh and above. Details based on this data are furnished below. 
Government, in 2015, issued "Framework for timely detection, reporting, 
investigation etc. relating to large value bank frauds" to Public Sector Banks (PSBs)  
for dealing with suspected frauds involving sums of money in excess of Rs. 50 crore, 
and instituting wide-ranging structural and procedural reforms through the framework 
and other steps to check fraudulent banking practices. Systematic and 
comprehensive checking, including of legacy stock of non -performing assets (NPAs) 
of PSBs, for  frauds under the framework has been taken note of by RBI in its Financial 
Stability Report of December 2019, in which RBI has observed that this has helped 
unearth frauds perpetrated  over a number  of years.  This is reflected  in the increased  
amount involved in frauds reported by SCBs and select FIs, from Rs.23,934 crore in 
the financial  year (FY) 2016 -17 to Rs. 41,167 crore in FY2017 -18, Rs.71,543 crore in 
FY2018-19, and  Rs.1,43,068 crore in the first three quarters of FY2019 -20. While 
improved detection and reporting have increased the reported amount involved in 
recent years, the comprehensive steps taken to check bank frauds have resulted in 
the amount involved  by  year  of  occurrence  of  fraud  showing  a  declining  trend,  
reducing  sharply from Rs.38,548 crore in FY2016-17 to Rs.16,084 crore in FY2017-18, 
increasing slightly to Rs.18,893 crore in FY2018-19, and declining again to Rs.5,244 
crore in the first three quarters of  FY2019-20. 
Similar declining trend is observed in respect of PSBs as well, with the amount 
involved by year of occurrence of fraud reducing sharply from Rs.35,578 crore in 2,043 
cases in FY 2016-17 to Rs.12,234 crore in 1,949 cases in FY2017-18, increasing slightly 
to Rs.15,575 crore in 1,250 cases in FY2018-19, and declining again to Rs. 3,781 crore  
in 436 cases in the first three quarters of  FY2019-20. 
RBI has clarified that the amount involved in frauds need not be the loss 
suffered by the reporting bank and may refer to the amount outstanding in the books 
of the reporting bank. Further, the entire amount lent need not have been diverted by 
the borrower/fraudster. 

54 [RAJYA SABHA]  
The steps taken to check fraudulent banking practices include, inter alia , the 
following:—  
(1) An online searchable database of frauds reported by banks, in the form of 
Central Fraud  Registry, has been set up to enable timely identification, control 
and mitigation of fraud risk and carrying out due diligence during the credit 
sanction process. 
(2) Governments framework for large value frauds in PSBs mandates: 
(i) Examination be initiated for wilful default immediately upon reporting fraud 
to RBI; 
(ii) Report on the borrower be sought from the Central Economic Intelligence 
Bureau in case an account turns NPA. 
(3) Fugitive Economic Offenders Act, 2018 has been enacted to provide for 
attachment of  property of a fugitive economic offender, confiscation of such 
offender's property and disentitlement of the offender from defending any civil 
claim. 
(4) PSBs have been advised to—  
(i) obtain certified copy of the passport of the promoters/directors and other 
authorised signatories of companies availing loan facilities of mor e than 
Rs.50 crore; 
(ii) decide on publishing photographs of wilful defaulters, in terms of the 
instructions of RBI and as per their Board-approved policy; and 
(iii) strictly ensure rotational transfer of officials/employees. 
(5) Heads of PSBs have been empowered to issue requests for issue of Look -Out 
Circulars. 
(6) For enforcement of auditing standards and ensuring the quality of audits, 
Government has established the National Financial Reporting Authority as an 
independent regulator. 
(7) In order to bring transparency and accountability in the larger financial system, 
bank accounts of 3.38 lakh inoperative companies have been frozen. 
In addition, to protect customers from fraud in digital transactions, RBI has 
advised banks to take, inter alia, the following security and risk mitigation 
measures: 

[4 FEBRUARY, 2020] 55  
(1) For securing card transactions, inclusive of online alerts for all transactions, 
certification of merchant terminals, and conversion of magnetic strip cards  to 
EMV chip and PIN cards; 
(2) Capping the value/mode of transactions/beneficiaries, setting daily limits  and  
issuing  alerts  upon  addition  of  beneficiaries; 
(3) Requiring PIN entry for all ATM transactions, and enabling all ATMs for 
processing EMV chip and PIN cards; 
(4) For securing Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPIs) also referred to as 'wallets', 
informing customers in case the same login is provided for PPI and other 
services offered by PPI issuers, having restrictions on multiple invalid attempts 
to log into PPI  and introducing time -out features, authenticating every wallet 
payment transaction by customer consent, in additional factor of authentication 
for debit cards, provision of customer- induced options for capping the number 
and value of transactions, provisi on of suitable cooling period for funds transfer 
on opening of PPI, and issue of alerts for PPI transactions.

[4 FEBRUARY, 2020] 59  
Establishment of Medical College Regulations, 1999, prescribes that the appropriate 
Government may allow the utilization of the facilities of a hospital owned and managed 
by it for establishing a Medical College by a person/agency/trust/society/company by 
entering into a Memorandum of Understanding for this purpose. The hospital to be 
transferred should be minimum 300 beds with necessary infrastructural facilities

fee proposed by an Institute is justified and the fee fixed by the Committee is binding

that the Commission shall frame guidelines for determination of fees and all other 
charges in respect of fifty per  cent of seats in private medical institutions and deemed 
to be universities  imparting medical education. Under the National Medical 
Commission Rules, the National Medical Commission has also been mandated with 
studying and suggesting measures to reduce the cost of medical education. Further, 
the Government is implementing a Centrally Sponsored Scheme for establishment of 
new medical colleges preferably in the underserved areas of the State. Thus, with the 
creation of more medical seats, the medical education shall be affordable.

Demand to reassess India's Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) targets 
SHRI MD. NADIMUL HAQUE (West Bengal): Sir, the Sustainable Development Goals 
are a globally accepted set of targets that countries should strive to achieve to ensure 
a sustainable future. While India improved upon her composite score on the  SDG 
index as compared to 2018, we have failed to achieve some crucial targets. Firstly, 
with regard to SDG - 2 of 'No Hunger', India's score fell by 13 points as compared to 
2018. More people have suffered from hunger and fallen into poverty in the last two 
years  than before. 
With regard to SDG - 10 dealing with 'income inequality', India's performance 
dipped compared to 2018 pointing to  increasing inequality in the country. All of these 
are worrying signs as more young workers are entering the formal job markets today. 
Furthermore, India's performance on the latest Global Hunger Index has also been a 
source of concern as our rank has fallen compared to previous years. Moreover, India 
was worse off in other crucial indicators including SDG - 16 of 'upholding peace, 
justice and  crucial institutions'. 
There is an urgent need for the Government to take cognizance of these 
important indicator s in order to completely fulfil these goals in the next decade. 
Effective stimulus must be injected into rural India, which has been seeing low 
consumption demand for the last few months. Schemes like MGNREGA should be 
allocated more funds than what has been seen in the Budgets of 2019 and 2020. I urge the 
Government  to aim  for sustainable and inclusive development for all. Thank you.

*Demand to preserve wetlands in Jharkhand
SHRI MAHESH PODDAR (Jharkhand) : Sir, preservation of wetland area is very much 
important for environment. This wetland area help save water during drought and at 
the time of floods it helps reduce the water level and hold dry soil fir m. Moreover, this 
serves as feeding, breeding and drinking area for wild animals. There is total 5,649 sq. 
km. of wetland areas in Jharkhand. Out of this 10 to 12 percent land is under 
encroachment which is posing threat to ecological balance. Apart from this there is 
hardly any effort to preserve such wetland area. 
Therefore, it is my request to the government that this issue should be taken 
into consideration and the state government should be directed to identify such 
wetland area which is under encroachment and along with this a master plan should 
also be chalked out to preserve such wetland area.

*Demand to bring a Bill to upgrade Andhra University College of Engineering to Indian 
Institute of Engineering Science and Technology 
SHRI V. VIJAYASAI REDDY (Andhra Pradesh): Sir, as a part of giving impetus  to  
higher education, the Government of India constituted the Anandakrishnan Committee 
to identify institutions for upgradation to the level of Institutes of National Importance. 
These upgraded institutions were to be called the Indian Institute of Engineering   
Science and Technology  (IIEST). 
The Committee submitted its Report and recommended that five institutions be 
upgraded to the level of IIEST. One such institution identified is Andhra University 
College of Engineering, Visakhapatnam, AP. The objective behind creating IIESTs is to 
have a new system of institutions in technical education and giving emphasis on 
research. 
Secondly, IIESTs are conceived to offer 5 -year integrated dual degrees in 
engineering, 5 -year integrated M.Sc., etc., and aim to emphasis o n specific 
research. Thirdly, IIESTs also have a specific provision for international students and 
faculty. 
But, unfortunately, the Report has not been implemented and no proposal has  
been mooted to upgrade Andhra University College of Engineering to the l evel of 
IIEST. It has been nearly 14 years since the Report was submitted by the Committee. 
In view of the above, I request Government of India, Ministry of HRD, to 
introduce and pass a Bill to upgrade Andhra University College of Engineering to the 
level of IIEST with departments like renewable energy, naval architecture, ship-
building, water and environmental research, etc., as it was done in the case of Bengal 
Engineering College in 2014 and the Institute of Technology, BHU, in 2012. 
Thank you.
